caption: the lizard-boy platformer's cult dig - tongue grappling, energy eating and honest 2004 charm.
about: Scaler (2004) is the hidden-gem platformer about bobby jenkins turning into a lizard: the tongue grapple swings like a grappling hook, eaten bugs become powers, and the enemy-swallowing loop gives the 3d platformer a bite most of its 2004 peers lacked. It shipped quietly, gathered a cult, and vanished - exactly the profile this catalogue digs for.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
